name: Hipertensão
description: The routine of the quiet town of Rio Belo changes with the arrival of Carina, a traveling actress determined to discover who her father is. At the same time, a mysterious crime involving the powerful Donana shakes the town.

videos.title: Chapter 1
videos.overview: The traveling troupe continues their journey when their truck breaks down in a small town. Renata decides to abandon her career as an artist. Sandro tries to get closer to Carina.

videos.title: Chapter 2
videos.overview: Napoleon is incredulous at Carina's resemblance to the twins. Marcos' children run away from home. Romeo and Candinho discover details of Carina's past.

videos.title: Chapter 3
videos.overview: The troupe is invited to lunch at the farm. Carina is hesitant about Candinho and Romeu's invitation. Sandro meets Chico. Napoleão begins to believe that Carina might be his daughter.

videos.title: Chapter 4
videos.overview: Napoleon invites Carina for a walk. Tulio meets Rachel in an unusual situation. Donana gives Chico an ultimatum and picks on the troupe. Napoleon makes a proposal to Carina.

videos.title: Chapter 5
videos.overview: Carina decides whether to stay on the farm. Renata talks to Sandro about his feelings for Carina. Donana receives an unexpected visitor.

videos.title: Chapter 6
videos.overview: Donana gets annoyed by Gioconda's arrival. Renata meets Marcos' children. Raimundo and Carola are dating. Marcos and Alaíde's meeting doesn't go as the wealthy man expected.

videos.title: Chapter 7
videos.overview: Raimundo confronts Donana. Marcos argues with his children about the incident with Alaíde. Carina and Renata have a surprise on their first night at the farm.

videos.title: Chapter 8
videos.overview: Napoleon imposes his hard line on the troupe members. Carina is hurt by Sandro. Renata starts working at Marcos' house. Donana makes a bombshell revelation to Carina.

videos.title: Chapter 9
videos.overview: Donana reaffirms to Carina that she recognizes her from a portrait. Renata begins to learn the routine of Marcos's house and faces resistance from Ceição. Raimundo fulfills Gioconda's wish.

videos.title: Chapter 10
videos.overview: Gioconda meets the three widowers and the rest of the troupe. Raimundo takes an interest in Carina and Luzia. Renata imposes her methods at Marcos's house. Carina is startled by Candinho.

videos.title: Chapter 11
videos.overview: Candinho thinks he is Carina's father. Carola and Renata argue. Odete questions Napoleão about Carina. Marcos plans Carola's party. Gioconda defends Chico and gets into trouble.

videos.title: Chapter 12
videos.overview: Donana finds Chico at her house. Napoleon and Romeo are jealous of Candinho being with Carina. Raimundo flirts with Luzia. Sandro makes up a lie about Renata.

videos.title: Chapter 13
videos.overview: Napoleon explains the reason for the argument with Candinho and Romeo to Sandro. Gioconda is suspicious of the relationship between Laerte and Donana. The guests arrive for Carola's party.

videos.title: Chapter 14
videos.overview: Sandro confronts Detective Joel over Carina. Raquel becomes even more enchanted by Túlio. The troupe performs at Carola's birthday party. Raimundo provokes a fight between Carola and Carina.

videos.title: Chapter 15
videos.overview: Donana makes advances towards Marcos. Carina opens her heart to Sandro. Donana questions Napoleão about Carina and her resemblance to the widower's wife. Sandro makes a confession to Fratello.

videos.title: Chapter 16
videos.overview: Romeo searches for the duck. Raimundo arranges a meeting with Luzia. Sandro asks Odete about the portrait. Carina decides to leave the farm. Gioconda decides to reveal a secret to Raquel.

videos.title: Chapter 17
videos.overview: Gioconda reveals to Raquel the reason for Donana's dislike of the girl. Raimundo meets with Luzia and makes a request to Chico. Sandro makes an important discovery about the widowers.

videos.title: Chapter 18
videos.overview: Sandro searches Napoleon's room, makes a discovery, and decides about the troupe. Laerte makes advances towards Renata. Donana uses her status as a "Penny-in-the-Shave" to get to the troupe.

videos.title: Chapter 19
videos.overview: Sandro understands Marcos's reason for wanting to get married again. Raquel writes another letter to Túlio. Romeo's ducks are found. Sandro has an unpleasant surprise.

videos.title: Chapter 20
videos.overview: Sandro suspects the three widowers in the money theft case. Gioconda claims Laerte is blackmailing Donana. Laerte and Renata grow closer. Sandro discovers the three widowers' secret.

videos.title: Chapter 21
videos.overview: Renata decides to leave with the troupe. Pé-de-Meia tries to find out more about his origins. Donana makes Laerte an offer. The three widowers put their plan into action to keep Carina on the farm.

videos.title: Chapter 22
videos.overview: The troupe's truck has a problem. Laerte continues to blackmail Donana and reminds her of a past crime. Pé-de-Meia's continued membership in the troupe is in jeopardy.

videos.title: Chapter 23
videos.overview: Carina and Tulio don't get along. Sandro talks to Donana. Romeu decides to tell Carina everything. Pé-de-Meia's whereabouts are discovered. Napoleão can't find the troupe's money.

videos.title: Chapter 24
videos.overview: Napoleon investigates the disappearance of the money. Raquel gets nervous talking to Túlio. The troupe performs a show at the farm. Raimundo and Viriato fight. Sabiá finds himself in a delicate situation.

videos.title: Chapter 25
videos.overview: The troupe recovers the money. Túlio acknowledges his feelings for Esperança. Marcos introduces another potential girlfriend to his family. Raquel suffers because of Túlio. Romeu gets into big trouble.

videos.title: Chapter 26
videos.overview: Romeo is taken to the police station. Sandro tries to adopt Pé-de-meia, but faces difficulties with the law. Luma suffers because of Marcos' family. Donana intimidates Raquel.

videos.title: Chapter 27
videos.overview: Luma runs away from Marcos' house. Romeu is kept in jail. Raquel asks Carola to go talk to Túlio in her place. Carina visits Romeu in jail. Marcos goes to ask Sandro for help.

videos.title: Chapter 28
videos.overview: Marcos asks Sandro for advice on raising his children. Raimundo approaches Carina on the street. Raquel arranges a meeting with Túlio. Candinho devises a plan to keep Carina away from Romeu.

videos.title: Chapter 29
videos.overview: Napoleon prevents Carina from drinking water laced with sleeping pills. Marcos announces to the family Renata's return as governess. Chico makes a request to Donana. Carina is assaulted by Raimundo.

videos.title: Chapter 30
videos.overview: Raimundo declares his desire for Carina. Renata returns to Marcos' house. Renata and Laerte are caught kissing. Sabiá suffers yet another injustice. Donana is cruel to Raquel.

videos.title: Chapter 31
videos.overview: Donana discovers Raquel's secret, who demands her rights. Doctor Victor considers separating from Fifi. Raimundo asks Túlio for help with Carina. Romeu deceives Boca Mole.

videos.title: Chapter 32
videos.overview: Renata puts her methods into practice with Carola. Gioconda overhears a conversation between Laerte and Donana. Romeu arrives at the farm. Sandro asks Marcos for help. Carola meets with Túlio.

videos.title: Chapter 33
videos.overview: Carola and Túlio kiss. Donana finds the paper she was looking for. Sandro is aggressive towards Carina. Raimundo discovers who Esperança is. Candinho acts against Sandro.

videos.title: Chapter 34
videos.overview: Carola is charmed by Túlio. Sandro tells Fratello that one of the widowers is Carina's father. Romeu is released. Carina confronts Raimundo. Laerte gets annoyed with Raquel, but is surprised.

videos.title: Chapter 35
videos.overview: Laerte threatens Donana. Romeu is released and gets drunk. Renata escapes a trap set for her. Gioconda discovers Donana's secret. Romeu gives Carina bombshell news.

videos.title: Chapter 36
videos.overview: Napoleon and Candinho try to mislead Carina. Raimundo and Luzia are caught. Carina and Sandro reconcile. Raimundo is persistent with Carina. Túlio and Carola meet again.

videos.title: Chapter 37
videos.overview: Gioconda, Carola and Túlio are together. Sandro avoids contact with Carina. Napoleão decides to hire a detective. Carola withholds information from Raquel. A bomb is placed in Donana's house.

videos.title: Chapter 38
videos.overview: Carola and Ceição are annoyed by Renata's orders. Laércio apologizes to Renata. Candinho confirms that he planted a bomb in Donana's house so he could be arrested.

videos.title: Chapter 39
videos.overview: Sandro considers making drastic decisions about the troupe's continued stay on the farm. Chico is outraged by a news report in the newspaper. Doctor Vitor threatens Fifi. Carola is caught with Túlio.

videos.title: Chapter 40
videos.overview: Túlio discovers the whole truth about Esperança. Raquel is disappointed with Carola. Raimundo and Carina kiss. Napoleão and Romeu try to thwart Candinho's plans.

videos.title: Chapter 41
videos.overview: Donana attacks Raquel and throws Gioconda out of the house. Detective Joel looks for Doctor Victor. Marcos is impressed by Renata's beauty. Raquel proposes a deal to Laerte.

videos.title: Chapter 42
videos.overview: Raquel tries to convince Laerte to get married. Raimundo confronts Donana about Gioconda. Sandro considers looking for Donana to find out about Carina's father. Raquel loses her temper with Carola.

videos.title: Chapter 43
videos.overview: Chico finds out about Fifi's gossip. Laerte responds to Raquel's marriage proposal. Sandro has an unpleasant surprise regarding Pé-de-Meia's adoption process.

videos.title: Chapter 44
videos.overview: Annoyed, Sandro goes to confront Candinho. Carina is disappointed with the three widowers. Luzia grieves over Raimundo. Renata is framed and makes a drastic decision.

videos.title: Chapter 45
videos.overview: Donana withdraws her complaint against Candinho. Renata decides to stay in her job. Candinho and Romeu hatch a plan to get the judge to reconsider his decision regarding Pé-de-Meia's adoption.

videos.title: Chapter 46
videos.overview: Donana is outraged by the possible marriage of Raquel and Laerte. Carina receives news about Pé-de-Meia's lawsuit. Raimundo and Carina have another explosive encounter.

videos.title: Chapter 47
videos.overview: Napoleon hires a detective to find out if Carina is his daughter. Carina receives medical attention after falling from a horse. Marcos is outraged by his sons' attitude towards his new suitor.

videos.title: Chapter 48
videos.overview: Sandro confirms his love for Carina and goes to confront Raimundo. Carina admits to Renata that Raimundo is affecting her. Napoleon plans to prevent Candinho and Romeu from leaving.

videos.title: Chapter 49
videos.overview: Donana tries to evict Chico and bribes Laerte. Carola plots against Renata. Napoleão and Odete devise a plan to keep Romeu and Candinho on the farm.

videos.title: Chapter 50
videos.overview: Chico is unjustly imprisoned, but gains support from allies. Romeu and Candinho's condition worsens. Renata and Carola remain in conflict. Carina succumbs to Raimundo's charms.

videos.title: Chapter 51
videos.overview: Raimundo makes a proposal to Carina. Romeu, drugged, reveals surprising news to Napoleão. Sandro is suspicious of Carina. Marcos is charmed by Renata.

videos.title: Chapter 52
videos.overview: Candinho decides to leave the farm, creating more conflict. Ceição overhears a suspicious conversation between Marcos. Raquel and Laerte begin planning their wedding.

videos.title: Chapter 53
videos.overview: Sandro and Carina clash. Napoleon lies about Candinho and Romeo. Fratelo and Sandro have a disagreement. Renata talks about her feelings with Carina.

videos.title: Chapter 54
videos.overview: Carina is surprised by an unexpected confession; Marcos is hiding something from his family. The group begins to suspect Candinho and Romeu's behavior.

videos.title: Chapter 55
videos.overview: Marcos tells Sandro that his company is facing financial problems. Candinho, Romeu, and Napoleão make Carina the sole heir. Raquel tells Laerte about Donana's trip.

videos.title: Chapter 56
videos.overview: Raimundo takes Luzia to his house. The troupe prepares a new show. Jealous, Sandro is rude to Carina. Laerte plots against Donana. Sandro catches Napoleão red-handed.

videos.title: Chapter 57
videos.overview: Napoleon invents an excuse to catch Sandro in the act. Tulio is rude to Carola. Laerte visits his uncle in prison. Candinho and Romeo fall into Napoleon's trap.

videos.title: Chapter 58
videos.overview: Marcos decides to sell the hotel. Raquel refuses to speak to Carola. The troupe's performance is cancelled. Candinho and Romeu are taken to the nursing home, much to Carina's sadness.

videos.title: Chapter 59
videos.overview: Odete tells Sandro that she helped sabotage Candinho and Romeu's drinks. Túlio thinks Renata is in love with him. Candinho and Romeu discover their true location.

videos.title: Chapter 60
videos.overview: Candinho and Romeu escape getting an injection. Túlio and Sandro argue. Renata suffers from a prank by Marcos' children. Sandro assaults Carina, who is left with lasting injuries.

videos.title: Chapter 61
videos.overview: Carina loses her sight. Renata decides to leave Marcos' house. Laerte lies to Donana. Napoleon tries to get Romeo and Candinho's forgiveness.

videos.title: Chapter 62
videos.overview: Candinho and Romeu return home. Donana prevents Chico from touching the hatchet. Laerte challenges Donana again. Carina discovers the reason for her blindness and fears for the future.

videos.title: Chapter 63
videos.overview: Romeo and Candinho go to talk to Carina. Donana decides to buy Marcos' hotel. Tulio confronts Sandro. Antonieta is suspicious of Beatriz. Renata is harassed by Marcos.

videos.title: Chapter 64
videos.overview: Renata suffers from harassment by Marcos and Laerte. Odete tells Raimundo to leave Luzia alone. Still drunk, Marcos receives medical attention. Carina begins psychological treatment.

videos.title: Chapter 65
videos.overview: Laerte's uncle threatens Donana. Renata suffers from Laerte's persistence. Raquel receives bad news from Laerte. Carola and Túlio reconcile. Beatriz reunites with Sandro.

videos.title: Chapter 66
videos.overview: Carlota tells Marcos about Renata and Laerte's kiss. Marcos sells the hotel to Donana. Gioconda confronts Laerte. Beatriz doesn't hide her interest in Sandro.

videos.title: Chapter 67
videos.overview: Beatriz decides to meet with Sandro. Donana offers Marcos a job. Laerte decides to keep his promise to marry Raquel. Raimundo shows Luzia around the hotel.

videos.title: Chapter 68
videos.overview: Raimundo makes false promises to Luzia, who disappears, worrying Odete. Laerte makes a demand of Donana regarding his marriage to Raquel. Chico surprises Donana.

videos.title: Chapter 69
videos.overview: Antonieta is caught at the forró dance and her secret is at risk. Chico gives Donana a moral lesson. Raquel is humiliated by Donana. Laerte gives Raquel an engagement ring.

videos.title: Chapter 70
videos.overview: Carina remembers scenes from her childhood and regains her sight. Napoleon suggests a risky plan to keep Carina on the farm. Raimundo blackmails Antonieta. Carina is jealous of Sandro.

videos.title: Chapter 71
videos.overview: Carina gets annoyed by Túlio's lack of interest in her. Napoleão offers shelter to Chico, who ends up suffering yet another injustice. Renata accepts Laerte's proposal.

videos.title: Chapter 72
videos.overview: Napoleon devises a plan to keep Carina on the farm. Luzia mistreats Carina. Túlio and Soninha kiss. Raul arrives in Rio Belo and immediately causes great confusion for Renata.

videos.title: Chapter 73
videos.overview: Renata faces a dilemma when confirming that Raul is her husband; Marcos tries to convince Renata to stay in the city. Luzia confronts Raimundo. Américo is thrilled by Raul's presence.

videos.title: Chapter 74
videos.overview: Raul agrees to pretend to be Renata's husband. Fratello gets closer to Antonieta. Odete discovers Luzia's secret. Marcos takes an unexpected action. Carina discovers something intriguing.

videos.title: Chapter 75
videos.overview: Carina discovers the secret of the three widowers and tries to find out who her father is. Renata asks América to question Marcos. Túlio compliments Raquel. Carina decides to stay on the farm.

videos.title: Chapter 76
videos.overview: Sandro tries to convince Carina to leave with the troupe. Laerte is saddened by the news about Renata's husband. Because she has to continue with the charade of the marriage, Renata is in despair.

videos.title: Chapter 77
videos.overview: Sandro claims that Carina decided to stay in Rio Belo because she loves Túlio. Beatriz is hired by Marcos. Carina confirms her feelings to Túlio. Marcos is surprised by Diogo.

videos.title: Chapter 78
videos.overview: Diogo and Marcos discuss the family's bankruptcy. Luzia fabricates a lie about Chico. Candinho disappears. Chico defends Antonieta. Carina tells Sandro about her discovery regarding the widowers.

videos.title: Chapter 79
videos.overview: Gioconda is distraught over Candinho's disappearance. Carina realizes that Sandro and Fratello already knew the secret of the three widowers. Donana is shocked by Gioconda's comment.

videos.title: Chapter 80
videos.overview: Donana freaks out after hearing news about Luzia. Antonieta opens her heart to Fratello. Donana humiliates and threatens Luzia. Napoleon receives a phone call about Candinho's whereabouts.

videos.title: Chapter 81
videos.overview: Sandro continues lying to Carina and makes a suggestion to her. Luzia is aggressive towards Carina. Raimundo proposes to Carina. Napoleon receives a call from a kidnapper.

videos.title: Chapter 82
videos.overview: Donana forbids Raimundo from marrying Carina. Sandro is worried about Carina's possible decision after Raimundo's request. Carina gives her answer to Raimundo.

videos.title: Chapter 83
videos.overview: Carina confirms she will marry Raimundo. Luzia vows revenge on Carina. Túlio agrees to get back together with Carola under certain conditions. Raimundo and Carina's wedding angers Donana.

videos.title: Chapter 84
videos.overview: Luiza points a gun at Raimundo. Beatriz promises Donana to intercede on her behalf with Marcos. Chico suffers an injustice at the hands of Luzia. Napoleon leaves to meet with the kidnapper.

videos.title: Chapter 85
videos.overview: Marcos tells his family about his financial situation. Laerte, once again, threatens Donana. Carlota is outraged at being poor. Chico makes a discovery that could change his life.

videos.title: Chapter 86
videos.overview: Luzia accuses Chico of kidnapping Candinho. Donana tries to find out who wrote the malicious article about Raquel's wedding. Napoleão decides whether Chico can stay on the farm.

videos.title: Chapter 87
videos.overview: Chico decides to leave the farm. Donana plots against Chico. Laerte tells Raimundo Donana's secrets. Sandro gets into trouble and Carina discovers the boy's lie.

videos.title: Chapter 88
videos.overview: Carina explodes at Sandro when she discovers that he already knew about the secret of the three widowers. Donana and Beatriz take Marcos' children to the park. Chico finds a place to sleep.

videos.title: Chapter 89
videos.overview: Sandro discovers Antonieta's secret. Fratello is annoyed by Raimundo's behavior towards Antonieta. Raul and Renata sleep in the same bed. Odette asks Sandro to help Luzia.

videos.title: Chapter 90
videos.overview: Odete tells Sandro about Raimundo's marriage promises to Luzia. Carina notices Sandro's coldness. Laerte makes a request to Donana. Napoleão discovers Candinho's whereabouts.

videos.title: Chapter 91
videos.overview: Carina is suspicious of the relationship between Raimundo and Luzia. Doctor Vitor warns Marcos about Donana. Laerte plots with Chico against Donana. Sandro decides to leave the farm without Carina.

videos.title: Chapter 92
videos.overview: Renata tells Marcos she's leaving. Chico disappears from town. Donana gives Raquel the inheritance document. Marcos declares his love for Renata. Sandro suffers from sabotage.

videos.title: Chapter 93
videos.overview: The troupe's truck is engulfed in flames. Sandro suspects who committed the crime. Beatriz decides to move to the farm. Raquel's wedding to Laerte begins.

videos.title: Chapter 94
videos.overview: Raquel and Laerte get married. Carola notices Donana's intentions towards her father. Donana tells Napoleon and Romeo that she has Carina's birth certificate.

videos.title: Chapter 95
videos.overview: Napoleon and Romeo are surprised when an envelope is opened. Donana investigates who stole it. Napoleon and Romeo take Candinho home, but there's something strange about the widower.

videos.title: Chapter 96
videos.overview: Candinho continues to have impaired memory. Laerte and Raquel enjoy their honeymoon. Sandro's attitude touches Carina. Sandro maintains a firm stance with Carina.

videos.title: Chapter 97
videos.overview: Carina is upset about losing the role in the play to Renata. Doctor Victor leaves home. Luzia threatens Carina. Sandro pleads with Carina about marrying Raimundo.

videos.title: Chapter 98
videos.overview: Sandro confesses his passion for Carina to Napoleon. Donana asks the mayor to harm Chico. Luzia pleads with Donana to marry Raimundo. Carina disappoints Raimundo.

videos.title: Chapter 99
videos.overview: Raimundo struggles to convince Carina not to end their relationship. Laerte tries to get even closer to Raquel. Luzia arranges a meeting with Raimundo. The troupe performs a show.

videos.title: Chapter 100
videos.overview: Odete is apprehensive about the meeting between Raimundo and Luzia. Túlio and Carlota talk. Carina, Raimundo, Chico, and Donana go to meet Luzia. A crime occurs in Rio Belo.

videos.title: Chapter 101
videos.overview: Luzia's death is confirmed. Túlio praises Sandro. Raul makes an appeal to Renata. Detective Joel investigates Luzia's death and finds an important clue about the possible perpetrator of the crime.

videos.title: Chapter 102
videos.overview: Odete tells Detective Joel that Luzia was murdered. Raimundo claims he is not Luzia's killer. Candinho regains his memory. The autopsy report on Luzia's death is released.

videos.title: Chapter 103
videos.overview: Renata reaffirms her love for Sandro to Carina. Chico is summoned to testify. Doctor Victor and Américo warn Marcos about Donana's schemes. Renata opens her heart to Sandro.

videos.title: Chapter 104
videos.overview: Renata announces she will fight for Sandro's love. Chico testifies about Luzia's murder. Raquel has an accident on her honeymoon. The three widowers make plans for Carina's future.

videos.title: Chapter 105
videos.overview: Sandro denies being in love with Carina. Beatriz prevents Gioconda from speaking to Marcos. Fifi lies to Donana about Chico. Detective Joel summons Carina to testify.

videos.title: Chapter 106
videos.overview: Carina confesses that she spoke with Luzia before the tragedy. Raquel and Laerte return from their honeymoon. Carina testifies at the police station about Luzia's murder.

videos.title: Chapter 107
videos.overview: Laerte considers giving up on Renata. Carina and Donana have a disagreement. Carina decides to run for mayor of Rio Belo. Chico's presence at Raquel's house bothers Donana.

videos.title: Chapter 108
videos.overview: The three widowers try to reunite Raul and Carina. Donana accuses Raquel of theft. Napoleon makes a proposal to Raul. Carina campaigns against Donana and receives support from the women of Rio Belo.

videos.title: Chapter 109
videos.overview: Carina mobilizes the women of the city against Donana. Túlio opposes Donana. Joel summons Raimundo to testify. A telegram arrives that could reveal Carina's origins.

videos.title: Chapter 110
videos.overview: Donana complains to the mayor about Túlio. Carina gets annoyed with Sandro and Renata. Túlio defends Antonieta against Raimundo. Carina agrees to marry Raul. Raquel and Laerte make a deal.

videos.title: Chapter 111
videos.overview: Mayor Zequinha threatens Túlio with dismissal. Donana takes advantage of Beatriz's plan to kiss Marcos. Doctor Victor warns Marcos about Donana. Raimundo testifies at the police station.

videos.title: Chapter 112
videos.overview: Raimundo recounts his last encounter with Luzia. The three widowers go to the doctor. Sandro makes a promise to Fratello. Beatriz pledges loyalty to Marcos. Túlio surprises the mayor.

videos.title: Chapter 113
videos.overview: Raquel's secret becomes Fifi's favorite topic. Raimundo and Túlio make peace. Donana catches Laerte and Renata in a compromising situation. Fratello makes a request to Antonieta.

videos.title: Chapter 114
videos.overview: Laerte and Raquel exchange confidences. Antonieta responds to Fratello's marriage proposal. Napoleon and Chico reconcile. Sabiá makes serious accusations against Donana at the police station.

videos.title: Chapter 115
videos.overview: Raimundo demands payment from Laerte. Gioconda proposes marriage to the three widowers. Chico's people's hatchet disappears. Carina investigates Sandro's feelings. Túlio is affectionate with Raquel.

videos.title: Chapter 116
videos.overview: Donana orders Detective Joel to find the hatchet. Chico and Donana accuse each other of theft. Sandro asks Raul what the writer's intentions are with Carina. Renata and Laerte kiss.

videos.title: Chapter 117
videos.overview: Renata confesses to Marcos that she is not married. Túlio becomes suspicious after Fifi's comment. Gioconda and Américo have a disagreement. Donana testifies at the police station and accuses Carina.

videos.title: Chapter 118
videos.overview: Carina discovers she was accused by Donana. Memories of the past haunt Carina. Túlio becomes interested in learning more about Raquel. Chico risks his life with a hatchet.

videos.title: Chapter 119
videos.overview: Odete reveals that Carina is the daughter of one of the three widowers. Donana asks Raimundo to return to Rio de Janeiro. Napoleão decides to stage the play at the farm. Gioconda is summoned to testify.

videos.title: Chapter 120
videos.overview: The troupe's new truck arrives. Carina is saddened by a detail on the truck. Gioconda testifies at the police station. Antonieta talks to Doctor Victor about Fifi. Carina accuses Renata.

videos.title: Chapter 121
videos.overview: Gioconda protests her arrest. Fifi has news about Doctor Victor. Chico tries to escape from jail. Donana demands money from Delegate Joel. Raimundo and Raquel confront Donana.

videos.title: Chapter 122
videos.overview: Laerte reaffirms his support for Raquel against Donana. Odete's threats frighten Napoleão. Gioconda and Chico are released from jail. Túlio invites Raquel out.

videos.title: Chapter 123
videos.overview: Carina confides in Renata. Marcos' children plot to bring Gioconda and Américo together. Sandro is honest with Renata. Viriato and Raimundo fight. The Rio Belo carnival ball begins.

videos.title: Chapter 124
videos.overview: Chico searches for the hatchet at Marcos' house. Raquel and Túlio meet at the dance. Laerte is disappointed. Fratello starts dating Antonieta. Carina loses her temper with Sandro.

videos.title: Chapter 125
videos.overview: Sandro decides to leave town alone. Laerte gives his statement at the police station. Beatriz and Marcos plot to deceive Donana. Renata reveals Sandro's feelings to Carina.

videos.title: Chapter 126
videos.overview: The three widowers receive a letter from a detective. Raquel confronts Donana again. Américo and Ceição think Renata is pregnant. Túlio admits his feelings for Raquel. Sandro looks for Carina.

videos.title: Chapter 127
videos.overview: Chico manages to escape from Fifi's house. Américo worries about Renata. Odete reaffirms her desire for revenge. Donana and Viriato make a deal. The troupe performs a show at the farm.

videos.title: Chapter 128
videos.overview: The kiss between Renata and Sandro causes confusion. Detective Joel orders Carina to testify again. Chico asks for help finding the hatchet. Raquel makes a bombshell confession to Donana.

videos.title: Chapter 129
videos.overview: Raquel refuses to show Carina's document to Donana and gives her mother an ultimatum. Donana appeals to Raimundo to convince Raquel. A ghost haunts the farm.

videos.title: Chapter 130
videos.overview: Donana blackmails Laerte. Raul talks to Sandro about Renata. Sandro advises Renata to forget him. Raul loses his temper with Carola. Sandro surprises Carina.

videos.title: Chapter 131
videos.overview: Carina is shaken by Sandro's kiss. Fratello promises to marry Antonieta. Raimundo demands money from Donana. Raul apologizes to Carola. Chico searches for his hatchet at the hotel.

videos.title: Chapter 132
videos.overview: Far from Carina, Sandro gets a role in a play. Chico runs from the police. Doctor Victor makes a decision about returning home. Laerte receives a job offer.

videos.title: Chapter 133
videos.overview: Detective Joel goes to the farm to arrest Chico. Gioconda decides to please Américo. Donana goes to Raquel's house to ask for Carina's birth certificate, and her daughter surprises her.

videos.title: Chapter 134
videos.overview: Carina testifies again at the police station. Doctor Victor returns home. Viriato reaffirms his alliance with Donana. Sandro acts in a play in Rio de Janeiro. Laerte makes a proposal to Raquel.

videos.title: Chapter 135
videos.overview: Raquel is embarrassed by Laerte's proposal. Carina loses control after Renata's question. Raquel decides to give Carina's birth certificate to the three widowers.
